artworks.title: Midas Washing at the Source of the Pactolus
artworks.description: Poussin's Metropolitan canvas — the Phrygian king scrubbing the golden curse from his hands in the Pactolus, Ovid's remedy made landscape.

artworks.title: Midas and Bacchus
artworks.description: Midas before Bacchus begging release from the gift that starves him — the golden touch as a theological bargain, not a fairy-tale joke.

artworks.title: King Midas with his Daughter
artworks.description: Crane's Wonder Book plate — Hawthorne's Midas discovering that the touch that gilds a rose can also freeze a child to gold.

artworks.title: The Golden Touch
artworks.description: Frye's illustration of the stranger's cure — plunge into the river, sprinkle the water, and wash the fatal gift away.

films.title: The Golden Touch
films.description: Disney's short made the golden-touch episode family cautionary fare — greed that turns breakfast to metal.

popCulture.title: Midas
popCulture.description: The golden-touch tale still names every deal that costs too much — Midas washing the curse in the Pactolus.
